method: per-criterion median across three judges, then weighted by the rubric

notes.problem: Flat slabs at 1.55 to 1, a beige band, the deck's brightest canvas.
notes.fix: Low raking key, one fixed offset per card, a dark curb and lawn.

notes.problem: Flat slabs, aliased shadow, a white bar, dots on asphalt.
notes.fix: A 0.3 m eye with a grazing key, the bar removed, dots on the fans.

notes.problem: Two flat aliased slabs; no card countable.
notes.fix: Fan with visible offsets under a grazing key from a 0.3 m eye.

notes.problem: Stock folders with no thickness or shadow.
notes.fix: Tighter crop, pressboard thickness raked by the window key.
A grazing key for thickness and contact.

notes.problem: Blank folders carry no money, year or deadline.
notes.fix: Three paper stacks, one per contract year, the first lit.

notes.problem: A small pod over a dead grey panel.
notes.fix: Behind the pod's shoulder with the parcel beyond the lens.

notes.problem: A generic box on a white wall.
notes.fix: Pull back so cut limbs and a lit house across the street show.
A draped vest, the eyeline up at the column, a cool rim.
Fit the vest, thin the sheaf to 11 mm, turn him away.
Letter-size notice in both hands, close the notch.
Camera right and lower so the pile and tires sit lit.
Cut the fill so the house falls to near black.

rounds_source: this module's own log of cards it has scored
